value.value: As-prepared material is described as crystalline, but its pattern matches no known cerium compound in the database. Similarity to the cited La(TEA)2 nitrate complex motivates a possible Ce analogue and a possible mixture with Ce(OH)4 and hydrated CeO2. These are proposed identities, not solved product coordinates or quantitative mixture fractions.
